comment: Davis et al. 2020 (Hypertension 76:1915), Fig. 3C: XE-991 (10 uM)-sensitive M current of Wistar rat stellate neurons (perforated patch, room temperature), from a deactivation protocol: held at -25 mV, stepped to -55 mV. Reported as a density, median -4.032 pA/pF (n = 11). Modelled here as the change of the M current between its steady state at -25 mV and its steady state at -55 mV (the full XE-991-sensitive current change over the step: instantaneous ohmic drop + deactivation relaxation). Protocol: the channel module alone, its boundary conditions clamped: E_K = -96.4979 mV (Nernst, Ko 4.5 / Ki 200 mM, 295.15 K; set in the instance parameters), A_mem 3000 um^2, T 295.15 K; V = -25 mV for 10 s (experiment 0, sub-experiment 0), then V = -55 mV for 10 s (sub-experiment 1); 10 s >= 20 tau_w at either voltage, so steady_state_avg (the mean over the second half of a sub-experiment) is the steady state. To redo: edit this file and run venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_modules.py --component i_M/Argus2026_v01 -k 'calibrate and davis2020_wistar' --include-unreviewed (rewrites davis2020_wistar_calibrated_parameters.csv and _calibration.json)

data_items.comment: Helper, not data: the steady-state M current at -25 mV, which the step difference below references (Davis2020 report only the difference). weight 0, so never scored; value 0 / std 1 are placeholders because libcuflynx requires every data_item to carry a value and std.

Helper, not data: the steady-state M current at -55 mV, which the step difference below references (Davis2020 report only the difference). weight 0, so never scored; value 0 / std 1 are placeholders because libcuflynx requires every data_item to carry a value and std.

Davis2020 Fig. 3C, Wistar: XE-991-sensitive M-current density -4.032 pA/pF (median, n = 11; legend), converted to a current with an ASSUMED cell capacitance Cm = 30 pF (not reported by Davis2020; the SN model's soma capacitance): -4.032 pA/pF x 30 pF = -120.96 pA = -0.12096 nA. std: the error bar of Fig. 3C, digitised (the 11 Wistar points give mean -3.90, SD 1.12, SEM 0.34 pA/pF, which is what the bar shows although the legend says median +- IQR), 0.34 pA/pF x 30 pF = 0.0102 nA. Value = i_M(steady state, -55 mV) - i_M(steady state, -25 mV).
